item.title: CVE-2026-115993 · 6.8 MEDIUM — Stored XSS in the “Notes” field of project checklists
item.description: Stored XSS vulnerability in the “Notes” field of the Checklists in Cervantes version v1.3-beta could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in another user's browser with elevated privileges

item.title: CVE-2026-115975 · 7.1 HIGH — Broken access control in JiraController
item.description: Broken access control in JiraController in Cervantes version v1.3-beta could allow an attacker to create, edit, or delete Jira tickets for vulnerabilities in other projects
